rule.description: AI agent audit messages
AI agent permission request or failed call
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) asked for permission to use $(jt_ai.tool)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)): $(jt_ai.tool) failed
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) uploaded a local file with curl or wget
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) used a file-sharing, tunnel or out-of-band service
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) opened a raw network connection (nc, socat, /dev/tcp)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) read a credential file: $(jt_ai.path)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) read or sent credentials or the environment from a shell command
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) read an environment file with secrets: $(jt_ai.path)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) set up persistence (cron, systemd, shell start-up file or authorized_keys)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) changed a persistence location: $(jt_ai.path)
[WARN] AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) cleared history or logs, or turned off auditing or a security control
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) changed accounts or privileges (users, sudo, setuid, capabilities)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) edited $(jt_ai.path)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) skipped the repository hooks (--no-verify)
[WARN] AI agent ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) changed the agent audit log, its hook or the managed settings
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) changed the Wazuh agent configuration on this host from a shell command
[WARN] AI agent ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) edited $(jt_ai.path): the agent audit or the managed settings
[WARN] AI agent ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) changed the agent audit log, its hook, its scheduled task or the managed settings on Windows
[WARN] AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) cleared event logs or history, or turned off Defender, auditing, the firewall or backups on Windows
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) set up persistence on Windows (scheduled task, service, Run key, Startup folder, WMI or PowerShell profile)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) changed accounts or privileges on Windows (local users, groups, UAC)
AI agent ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) ran a destructive command in $(jt_ai.cwd)
[WARN] AI agent ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) sent a destructive command to $(jt_ai.remote)
AI agent ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) changed its own settings $(jt_ai.path) (permissions, hooks or plugins)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) changed VS Code settings $(jt_ai.path) (auto-approve could be turned on there)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) touched VS Code's auto-approve setting from a shell command
AI agent ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) changed agent settings or turned off its safeguards from a shell command (permissions, hooks, plugins)
AI agent ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) read a private key or credential file: $(jt_ai.path)
AI agent ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) read or copied a private key or credential file from a shell command
AI agent ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) downloaded and ran a script in one command
AI agent ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) connected to $(jt_ai.remote) over SSH
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) ran a shell command in $(jt_ai.cwd)
AI agent ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) ran a shell command with all permission prompts off
AI agent ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) changed $(jt_ai.path)
AI agent audit: Gemini CLI's audit hook is turned off for $(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host): $(jt_ai.gemini_hook_off)
User $(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host) put a password or token into a prompt to AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) (removed from the record; it has gone to the AI provider, replace it)
User $(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host) sent a prompt to AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.prompt_len) characters) in session $(jt_ai.session)
AI agent audit on $(jt_ai.host): prompt recording is now $(jt_ai.prompts) (was $(jt_ai.previous))
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) session $(jt_ai.session) started ($(jt_ai.source)) by $(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host) in $(jt_ai.cwd), mode $(jt_ai.mode)
AI agent session started by $(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host) with all permission prompts off (bypassPermissions)
AI agent ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) used $(jt_ai.tool): $(jt_ai.url)$(jt_ai.query)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) called MCP tool $(jt_ai.tool)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) ran a Code Mode script ($(jt_ai.js_len) characters) that can call MCP tools and make HTTP requests
AI agent ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) started a subagent ($(jt_ai.task_subagent_type)): $(jt_ai.task_description)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) started subagent $(jt_ai.subagent) in session $(jt_ai.session)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) session $(jt_ai.session) on $(jt_ai.host) ended ($(jt_ai.reason))
AI agent ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)): $(jt_ai.tool) $(jt_ai.path)$(jt_ai.pattern)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) ran a command with a password or token in it (removed from the record)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) session on $(jt_ai.host) started over SSH from a public address $(jt_ai.ssh_from)
[WARN] AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) ran four or more destructive commands within ten minutes in session $(jt_ai.session)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) uploaded a local file through the browser: $(jt_ai.path)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) ran JavaScript ($(jt_ai.js_len) characters) in a browser page: it runs with the page's login and can read its cookies and content
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) read the browser's network requests or cookies (they can carry session tokens)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) typed into a password or one-time-code field in the browser ($(jt_ai.element))
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) opened an internal or administration page in the browser: $(jt_ai.url)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) browser $(jt_ai.browser_action) $(jt_ai.url)$(jt_ai.element)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) ran JavaScript or typed a password in the browser after opening an internal or administration page in session $(jt_ai.session)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) changed its MCP servers from a shell command (new tools for the agent)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) edited an MCP server configuration: $(jt_ai.path)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) read a browser's cookies or saved passwords, or a keychain: $(jt_ai.path)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) ran a network scanner
[WARN] AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) ran a cryptocurrency miner
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) changed a CI/CD pipeline: $(jt_ai.path)
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) captured the screen or read the clipboard from a shell command
AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) added a git remote or pushed to an address given on the command line
[WARN] AI agent $(jt_ai.agent) ($(jt_ai.user) on $(jt_ai.host)) sent data out after reading credentials in the same session $(jt_ai.session)
AI agent audit: $(file) was added or changed (the hook, the opencode plugin or the managed agent settings)
[WARN] AI agent audit: $(file) was deleted (the hook, the opencode plugin or the managed agent settings)
jt-ai-agent: inventory event
AI coding agent $(jt_ai_inv.tool) found on $(jt_ai_inv.agent_name), which is not in the agent group ai-agent: its actions are not audited ($(jt_ai_inv.evidence))
AI coding agent $(jt_ai_inv.tool) on $(jt_ai_inv.agent_name): the host is in the group ai-agent, but the audit hook is not installed ($(jt_ai_inv.evidence))
AI coding agent $(jt_ai_inv.tool) found on $(jt_ai_inv.agent_name); it has no hook mechanism, so its actions cannot be audited ($(jt_ai_inv.evidence))
Local model server $(jt_ai_inv.tool) on $(jt_ai_inv.agent_name), not listening on the network ($(jt_ai_inv.evidence))
Local model server $(jt_ai_inv.tool) on $(jt_ai_inv.agent_name) listens on the network ($(jt_ai_inv.listen)); it has no authentication by default
AI coding agent $(jt_ai_inv.tool) is running on $(jt_ai_inv.agent_name) but sent no audit line for 24 hours: its hook may be turned off or not configured ($(jt_ai_inv.evidence))
AI coding agent $(jt_ai_inv.tool) on $(jt_ai_inv.agent_name) is working but its actions are not audited (restart the session after the hook is installed): $(jt_ai_inv.evidence)
AI coding agent $(jt_ai_inv.tool) found on $(jt_ai_inv.agent_name); jt-ai-agent cannot enforce an audit hook for it (user-level hooks only), so its actions are not audited ($(jt_ai_inv.evidence))
jt-ai-agent inventory: $(jt_ai_inv.was) for $(jt_ai_inv.tool) on $(jt_ai_inv.agent_name) is gone
jt-ai-agent inventory could not read the agent inventory: $(jt_ai_inv.detail)
